title: Citric acid: summary of evaluations performed by the Joint FAO/WHO Expert Committee on Food Additives
authors: Joint FAO/WHO Expert Committee on Food Additives
journal: IPCS INCHEM, JECFA evaluation summary, page dated 12 Nov 01
funder: not stated; summary of evaluations of the Joint FAO/WHO Expert Committee on Food Additives, published on IPCS INCHEM.
result: INS 330; JECFA No. 218. Chemical names: 2-hydroxy-1,2,3-propane-tricarboxylic acid and its monohydrate. Functional classes: acidulant, synergist for antioxidant, sequestrant, flavouring agent. Latest evaluation 1973 (17th meeting, TRS 539; toxicological monograph FAS 5): ADI not limited, a group ADI for citric acid and its calcium, potassium, sodium and ammonium salts. The 1966 evaluation also set an ADI not limited.
